current.text: He is projected as a bench player. One preseason preview lists Isaiah Joe as sixth man, then Ron Holland, Paul Reed and Daniss Jenkins.
An expert expects him to play more minutes alongside Ausar Thompson this season.
Detroit's power forward depth is very weak unless Ausar Thompson and Holland play the four, which could open frontcourt minutes for him.
Detroit used a deep 12 to 13 player rotation last season that limited everyone's minutes.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest risks are expected.

tags.name: deep rotation
tags.detail: Detroit used a 12 to 13 player rotation last season. He comes off the bench.

tags.name: winning team
tags.detail: Projected 50 to 51 wins and a third or fourth seed in the East

note: Holland is not a draft target for us. Yahoo ranks him 272 and ESPN ranks him 245, both value him at 0 USD, and our league drafts only 144 players. He projects as a bench forward at about 19 to 20 minutes with no category strong enough to carry a roster spot. The two sites also disagree on his FT% (68 vs 80) and blocks (0.8 vs 0.3). Early in the season, check whether Detroit plays him at the four next to Ausar Thompson and whether his minutes rise clearly above 20. If they do, he is a waiver pickup for steals and low turnovers.
